sourceDocuments.title: Agronomic Performance of Drought-Tolerant Maize Hybrids
sourceDocuments.text: Nitrogen use efficiency in tropical maize genotypes depends on root system architecture and mycorrhizal symbiosis under drought stress conditions in the Guinea savannah zone.

studentDocument.title: Yam Tuber Dormancy and Post-Harvest Rot Management
studentDocument.text: Dioscorea rotundata post-harvest storage losses are primarily driven by fungal rot pathogens including Aspergillus niger and Penicillium sclerotigenum. Pre-storage treatment with biological biocontrol antagonists significantly reduces decay rates during ambient warehouse curing in traditional yam barns.
